selectorIssue.details: The first runner version treated #terminal-actions.isVisible() as proof of settlement. That container is visible from startup because its CSS display:flex overrides its hidden attribute; #terminal-text was empty at the recorded detection times (portrait 24 ms, desktop 174 ms). The early selector signal cannot prove a terminal, and the run did not prove a visible replay transition.
selectorIssue.supersedes: terminal and replay fields in qa-natural-fixed-report.json are not valid evidence because they were based on the faulty selector gate.
